info.title: Vitae API
info.description: Private career-system REST surface. All `/api/v1` routes are default-deny except explicit auth helpers. Hosted Cloud requests resolve an authenticated member workspace on the server. Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details?, request_id } }`. Cookie session and Bearer JWT are equivalent.

servers.description: Local origin (for health and provider webhooks)

bearerAuth.description: Owner session JWT from Google or POST /auth/dev-login. Cookie session is equivalent.

paddleWebhookSignature.name: paddle-signature
paddleWebhookSignature.description: Paddle HMAC header for the exact raw JSON bytes. The server rejects re-serialized or unsigned payloads.

workspace.description: Null outside Cloud mode or before an account has been bootstrapped.

localInstall.description: True when this process is a loopback-bound personal production install.

totals.description: Whole-workspace record, relationship, community and component counts.

linked.description: Whether the event resolved to a known workspace

ApplicationWrite.description: The node envelope without `type`. On PATCH, `props` merges onto what is stored and an explicit null clears a key, which is not how the generic node patch behaves. Note that the application status is `props.status`; the envelope has an unrelated top-level `status` of its own, and setting it there does nothing.

title.description: Falls back to props.role_title when omitted or blank.

correction.description: A correction says the recorded status was never true, rather than that the application moved. It skips the transition check and is available from a closed record, because an operator who mis-recorded an outcome would otherwise be held there. It cannot write a status outside the enum.

recorded.description: False when the status was resubmitted as itself. Nothing is written, because a revision recording a move that did not happen would be a false line in a history whose whole value is that every line is true.

pages.description: Null where the page count could not be determined, rather than a zero that would read as "compiled, and came out empty".

tex.description: Always present, including when the compile failed, so a download of the source is always available.
